name: ClassWeekGrid
job: Show a weekly class or appointment timetable as a compact grid of time blocks with today's column lifted and the next session highlighted
visitor_action: tap a block for details; tap a type chip to filter the grid
mobile: one day at a time with day chips, swipe between days
motion: tiles settle in by column, today column lifts with spring (reduced-motion: static grid)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Studio linen: oat-white ground, sage, clay and denim block colours, soft rounded paper tiles with hairline shadow
notes: Not rendered by the builder (QA sweep does that). Known weakness: type names show on tiles only in today's column, so other columns lean on colour plus the filter chips.
